android.desc:
Are you tired of missing out on free game giveaways from your favorite stores like Steam, EPIC Games, Indiegala, and more? Say goodbye to FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) with GG: Game Giveaways Notifier! Our app ensures you never miss a free game, loot, or giveaway again.

Stay Ahead with Instant Notifications
With GG: Game Giveaways Notifier, you’ll receive instant push notifications the moment a game becomes free or a giveaway launches on any platform. Be the first to know about exclusive game giveaways, free coins, skins, battle passes, and other exciting in-game items.

Comprehensive Giveaway Listings
Discover a detailed list of all active game giveaways and free in-game items. Each listing comes with clear instructions on how to redeem them, so you never miss out on the goodies. Whether it’s free games, loot, coins, skins, or battle passes, we’ve got you covered.

Save Money and Compete
Track your savings effortlessly with GG. See how much money you’ve saved by snagging free games and in-game items. Plus, compete with other users on our leaderboard and earn bragging rights as the ultimate giveaway guru.

Clean and Minimal UI
Navigate our app with ease thanks to its clean and minimal user interface. Enjoy a seamless browsing experience as you hunt for the latest free games and giveaways.

All Storefronts Covered
No matter where you get your games from, GG has you covered. We track giveaways from a wide range of platforms including Epic Games, Steam, itch.io, and many more. Stay updated on free game offers from PC, Android, iOS, Web, Nintendo, Mac, Linux, and beyond.

Open Source and Actively Maintained
GG: Game Giveaways Notifier is open source and actively maintained. Our dedicated team is constantly updating the app to provide you with the best experience possible. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that you’re using a reliable and trustworthy app.

Email Notifications
Prefer email notifications? No problem! With just a simple toggle, you can opt to receive notifications via email, ensuring you never miss out on any free game offers.

Download GG: Game Giveaways Notifier Now!
Join the community of savvy gamers who never miss a free game or giveaway. Download GG: Game Giveaways Notifier today and start saving money while enjoying the latest free games and in-game items. Don’t miss out – get GG now and stay in the loop!

quotes.text:
I've made  an app to solve a personal problem of mine. I'm a game hoarder and I've managed to get more than 500 games for free through giveaways and saved thousands of dollars. So, whenever I missed a giveaway, it was really painful. As a result, I've made GG: Game Giveaways Notifier. It's the one-stop solution for all your gaming giveaway needs. GG notifies you through push notification and email (opt-in) whenever a game goes free. Here's why you should check it out:

- Instant Notifications : Never miss a free game again! Get push notifications whenever a game goes free.
- Comprehensive List of Giveaways : From free games to loot, coins, skins, and battle passes, see a detailed list of giveaways with instructions on how to redeem them.
- Save Money and Compete : Keep track of how much money you've saved through the app and compete in the leaderboard. Bragging rights guaranteed!
- Clean and Minimal UI : Enjoy a nice, clean, and easy-to-navigate user interface.
- All Storefronts Covered : Whether it's Epic Games, Steam, itch.io, or others, we've got you covered.
- Open Source and Actively Maintained : GG is open source and constantly updated to give you the best experience.
- Email Notifications (Coming Soon) : Soon, you'll be able to receive notifications via email too! It's a toggle in the app and the feature is complete. Just ironing out some bugs.

Screenshots: https://i.imgur.com/LK2WP9p.jpg
